evals.prompt: Connect Codex to the LetMeSendEmail MCP server.
evals.expected_output: Gives the config.toml block or one-liner with bearer_token_env_var = LETMESENDEMAIL_API_KEY.
expectations: Uses LETMESENDEMAIL_API_KEY env var (not a pasted key)

evals.prompt: My agent gets `forbidden` calling mailbox-messages-send. The key works for listing.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses missing mailbox:send ability (Reader vs Full assistant) per abilities.md — not an auth failure.
expectations: Does not suggest re-authenticating or a new key as the first fix

evals.prompt: List all messages in a mailbox with 500 emails.
evals.expected_output: Cursor pagination: limit/cursor loop on next_cursor while has_more.
expectations: Does not claim a single call returns everything
